caption: The drawing depicts two detailed objects, each resembling orthopaedic braces or prosthetic devices, placed against a plain, off-white background. The upper object is colored in dark brown tones with black shading and has visible metallic elements in brass or gold colors, including rivets and a buckle around the central section. The structure appears rigid with a curved form, and it has straps and textured elements, suggesting the use of leather and metal. The lower object is smaller, mainly in a beige or light tan color with similar metallic fastenings and rivets, also showing a combination of rigid and flexible parts. The overall composition features the two objects centered and separated horizontally, with the artist's name "Harry Grossen" below the upper object and some small, handwritten numbers or notes in the lower right corner.
title: Woman's Clogs
